label: q36-35b-ollama-mlx-q4
display: Ollama MLX runner (MLX 4-bit + MTP head, adaptive depth)
note: Ollama's MLX runner on the same MLX 4-bit weights Kapitsa, mlx-lm, oMLX and MTPLX read, with the pack's MTP head, imported into a dedicated store without copying (tools/ollama_mlx_import.py: APFS clones with Ollama's tensor names; plain `ollama create` would copy 21 GB and mislabel the 8-bit router gates as 4-bit). Ollama's own speculation: built-in MTP with its adaptive depth controller (no knobs; the depth persists across requests, hence the 3 extra warm-up decodes). Parameters mirror the official qwen3.6 tag; requests override presence_penalty and sampling as for every engine. The official MLX tag (qwen3.6:35b-a3b-nvfp4) is a different, larger quantization (NVFP4, BF16 head and MTP experts).
